script.validation: Syntax compile only; neither browser nor final review stage executed.

sequence: Wait for actual full mandatory pnpm test:e2e exit0, exact discovered cases all passed with0skips/failures/flakes, unchanged test/runtime source. Failed05 is never eligible.

Read fresh full command.log/results/command and selected action/acceptance reports; prepare an explicit JSON files list of exact path+SHA. Review new screenshots/documents before marking contentReview.actuallyReviewed. Never enumerate all output directories for publication.

Run browser stage once with actual successful run-id and selection. It refuses running/failed results, changed hashes, forbidden private files, secret findings, unreviewed media and overwriting any existing report.
Only then allow candidate generation. Once candidate is hash-bound, do not rewrite FULL_BROWSER_PUBLICATION_REVIEW or the initial296 review.

After final canonical reports, prepare final selection union plus exact entrypoints for candidate, UX, COMMANDS and other final reports. Provide explicit code-source manifest for sourcePath references. Run final stage once. Every evidencePaths/sourcePath/logPath/recordPath reference must resolve to selected evidence or code-source hash; missing references block output.

files.path: Exact relative file path under evidence root

contentReview.reviewer: Actual reviewer name, required for new media only

reviewedNonSecretMatches.reason: Only an independently inspected benign match; no blanket rule suppression

knownMutableReplacements: ROOT_COMMANDS_DRAFT.json changed from initial53record bytes to54records; prior bytes unavailable, do not invent snapshot
ENVIRONMENT_POWER_EVENTS.json will change when process-scoped wakeguard is released
EXTERNAL_GATES.json will become final4-gate envelope; EXTERNAL_GATES_REVIEWED stays immutable
hardExclusions: Credential-bearing raw command rejections and .cjs helpers
historicalMissingReferences: Keep NOT_RUN or user-excluded facts as metadata; nonexistent paths cannot be accepted as evidence/source/log references. Use reviewed sanitized summary references for excluded private originals.
selfHashPolicy: Each output excludes itself from files; exclusive creation prevents accidental overwrite. Final manifest may include the two earlier immutable reviews.
textFormats: UTF-8 JSON/TXT/LOG/MD/JSONL/TSV. MVP_COVERAGE_FINAL.tsv gets complete text scan; finalizer owns its exact52-row structural validation.

exactSafeSummaryException.review: Entire actual summary read; any different path/hash remains forbidden by fixture rule.
